model: adult zebrafish (Danio rerio), generic wild type, sex not specified, segmented for a cutaway viewer
units_and_axes: glTF Y-up; head at +X, back at +Y, fish's left side at -Z. Standard length (snout to caudal fin base) = 0.78 units; total length about 1.00 units.

max_body_depth_over_SL.measure: body depth at the dorsal fin origin / SL
max_body_depth_over_SL.derivation: 1 / 3.49, the mean SL-to-depth ratio of control zebrafish

depth_at_nape_over_SL.derivation: Parichy 2009 Table 3, 'Prediction of SL and HAA from other quantitative measures': SL = 4.12 x X + 1.62, evaluated at SL = 25.7 mm (Hur 2017); beyond ~15 mm SL the regressions depart moderately from linearity

depth_at_anal_origin_over_SL.measure: height at anterior margin of anal fin (HAA) / SL
depth_at_anal_origin_over_SL.derivation: Parichy 2009 Table 3, 'Prediction of SL and HAA from other quantitative measures': SL = 3.56 x X + 4.40, evaluated at SL = 25.7 mm (Hur 2017); beyond ~15 mm SL the regressions depart moderately from linearity

head_length_over_SL.derivation: Parichy 2009 Table 3, 'Prediction of SL and HAA from other quantitative measures': SL = 3.29 x X + 0.73, evaluated at SL = 25.7 mm (Hur 2017); beyond ~15 mm SL the regressions depart moderately from linearity

eye_diameter_over_SL.derivation: Parichy 2009 Table 3, 'Prediction of SL and HAA from other quantitative measures': SL = 9.49 x X + 0.22, evaluated at SL = 25.7 mm (Hur 2017); beyond ~15 mm SL the regressions depart moderately from linearity

snout_vent_over_SL.derivation: Parichy 2009 Table 3, 'Prediction of SL and HAA from other quantitative measures': SL = 1.48 x X + 0.55, evaluated at SL = 25.7 mm (Hur 2017); beyond ~15 mm SL the regressions depart moderately from linearity

vertebrae_total.measure: vertebrae (4 Weberian + 10 precaudal + 15 caudal + 3 caudal fin)
vertebrae_total.derivation: 3-4 caudal fin vertebrae reported, 3 used; Van Wynsberghe 2023 gives 31

caudal_fin_principal_rays.derivation: inferred from 'fewer than 18 principal rays' in treated fish

gill_arches_per_side.measure: gill-bearing branchial arches per side (branchial arches 1-4)

ontology: ZFA ids (zebrafish anatomy ontology) looked up in Ubergraph; uberon_id is the Uberon class that carries the ZFA id as a database cross-reference. Calls in anatomy-model/zebrafish/calls.json
layers: outer (skin, eyes, fin membranes, barbels, lateral line) / muscle / skeleton / organ
